name.en: LMU-NU collaborative online USMLE review classes

audience.en: Upper-year medical students (the classes began in 2016 for fourth- and fifth-year students)
audience.ja: 高学年の医学生（2016年に4年生と5年生を対象に開始）

howToApply.en: The schedule is announced on NUCT. Undergraduates who wish to join contact the office.
howToApply.ja: 日程はNUCTで案内します。参加を希望する学部生は国際連携室に連絡してください

toConfirm: Current academic-year schedule, and whether the class still runs every other week with students of LMU and Gifu University.

text.en: The schedule is announced to Nagoya students on NUCT. Ask the office if you cannot see it.
text.ja: 日程は、学内の学生にNUCTで連絡されます。見られない場合は国際連携室に問い合わせてください
